question: It seems that Otto’s family didn’t make fun of him or tease him, so in other words, Otto’s family must have all been saints? It feels like if they weren’t at that level, they couldn’t have been kind to Otto.
answer: I think that maybe among your friends or class, there’s someone who’s in the position of a teased character, but I think the probability is high that they don’t hold that position in their own family. Otto’s character is a natural at being teased.
